#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class CF884F {
public:
    CF884F() : out(stdout) {}
    void main();

private:
    ostream& out;
    istream& in = cin;

    static const int A = 26, INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    vector<int> oo, oh;
    int __ = 1;

    int link(int o, int h) {
        oo[__] = o;
        oh[__] = h;
        return __++;
    }

    vector<int> ii, jj, cc, cost, cost_;
    int m_;
    vector<int> ae, pi, dd, ff;
    int n_;
    vector<int> pq, iq;
    int cnt;

    void init() {
        oo.assign(1 + m_ * 2, 0);
        oh.assign(1 + m_ * 2, 0);
        ii.assign(m_), jj.assign(m_), cc.assign(m_ << 1), cost.assign(m_), cost_.assign(m_);
        pi.assign(n_), dd.assign(n_), ff.assign(n_);
        ae.assign(n_);
        pq.assign(1 + n_), iq.assign(n_);
        cnt = 0;
    }

    void link_(int i, int j, int c, int co) {
        int h = m_++;
        ii[h] = i;
        jj[h] = j;
        cc[h << 1] = c;
        cost[h] = co;
        ae[i] = link(ae[i], h << 1);
        ae[j] = link(ae[j], h << 1 | 1);
    }

    bool less(int u, int v) {
        return pi[u] < pi[v] || (pi[u] == pi[v] && dd[u] < dd[v]);
    }

    int i2(int i) {
        i *= 2;
        if (i > cnt) return 0;
        if (i < cnt && less(pq[i + 1], pq[i])) return i + 1;
        return i;
    }

    void pq_up(int u) {
        int i = iq[u], j, v;
        for (; (j = i / 2) > 0 && less(u, v = pq[j]); i = j)
            pq[iq[v] = i] = v;
        pq[iq[u] = i] = u;
    }

    void pq_dn(int u) {
        int i = iq[u], j, v;
        for (; (j = i2(i)) > 0 && less(v = pq[j], u); i = j)
            pq[iq[v] = i] = v;
        pq[iq[u] = i] = u;
    }

    void pq_add_last(int u) {
        pq[++cnt] = u;
        iq[u] = cnt;
        pq_up(u);
    }

    int pq_remove_first() {
        int u = pq[1], v = pq[cnt--];
        if (v != u) {
            iq[v] = 1;
            pq_dn(v);
        }
        iq[u] = 0;
        return u;
    }

    bool dijkstra(int s, int t) {
        std::fill(pi.begin(), pi.end(), INF);
        pi[s] = 0;
        pq_add_last(s);
        while (cnt > 0) {
            int i = pq_remove_first();
            int d = dd[i] + 1;
            for (int o = ae[i]; o != 0; o = oo[o]) {
                int h_ = oh[o];
                if (cc[h_] > 0) {
                    int h = h_ >> 1;
                    int j = i ^ ii[h] ^ jj[h];
                    int p = pi[i] + (((h_ & 1) == 0) ? cost_[h] : -cost_[h]);
                    if (pi[j] > p || (pi[j] == p && dd[j] > d)) {
                        if (pi[j] == INF)
                            pq_add_last(j);
                        pi[j] = p;
                        dd[j] = d;
                        ff[j] = h_;
                        pq_up(j);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return pi[t] != INF;
    }

    int trace(int s, int t) {
        while (t != s) {
            int h_ = ff[t], h = h_ >> 1;
            cc[h_]--;
            cc[h_ ^ 1]++;
            t ^= ii[h] ^ jj[h];
        }
        return 1;
    }

    int edmonds_karp(int s, int t) {
        for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++) {
            int i = ii[h], j = jj[h];
            pi[j] = min(pi[j], pi[i] + cost[h]);
        }
        for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++) {
            int i = ii[h], j = jj[h];
            cost_[h] = cost[h] + pi[i] - pi[j];
        }
        int f = 0;
        while (dijkstra(s, t)) {
            f += trace(s, t);
            for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++) {
                int i = ii[h], j = jj[h];
                if (pi[i] != INF && pi[j] != INF) {
                    cost_[h] += pi[i] - pi[j];
                }
            }
        }
        int ans = 0;
        for (int h = 0; h < m_; h++)
            ans += cc[h << 1 | 1] * cost[h];
        return ans;
    }

public:
    void main() {
        int n;
        in >> n;
        n /= 2;
        n_ = 1 + n + A + 1;
        m_ = n + n * A + A;
        init();

        string s;
        in >> s;
        vector<int> bb(n * 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < n * 2; i++)
            in >> bb[i];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            link_(0, 1 + i, 2, 0);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int j = n * 2 - 1 - i;
            int ai = s[i] - 'a';
            int aj = s[j] - 'a';
            for (int a = 0; a < A; a++) {
                int b;
                if (a == ai && a == aj)
                    b = max(bb[i], bb[j]);
                else if (a == ai)
                    b = bb[i];
                else if (a == aj)
                    b = bb[j];
                else
                    b = 0;
                link_(1 + i, 1 + n + a, 1, -b);
            }
        }

        vector<int> kk(A, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n * 2; i++) {
            int a = s[i] - 'a';
            kk[a]++;
        }

        for (int a = 0; a < A; a++)
            link_(1 + n + a, n_ - 1, kk[a], 0);

        out << -edmonds_karp(0, n_ - 1) << "\n";
    }
};

int main() {
    CF884F solver;
    solver.main();
    return 0;
}
